title: Hermes Agent will let employees share AI skills across their company
teaser: Nous Research has added Collective Wisdom to Hermes Agent, allowing employees to share skills the agent has developed from successful workflows with their team after review. Soon, companies will also be able to run the open-source Hermes Agent directly in Microsoft Teams, assigning it financial analysis, document preparation and inbox sorting, then reviewing its work in the same chat. The agent runs in isolated Azure Container Apps Sandboxes micro-VMs.
